85cda4b338cb5ea1f757.en: To work out 84 ÷ 4, split 84 into parts that are easy to divide.
85cda4b338cb5ea1f757.id: Untuk menghitung 84 ÷ 4, pecah 84 menjadi bagian-bagian yang mudah dibagi.

c66ce23b124ad5c9bca0.en: In a story, think about what the remainder means. 26 children travel in cars of 4.
c66ce23b124ad5c9bca0.id: Dalam soal cerita, pikirkan arti sisanya. 26 anak pergi naik mobil, setiap mobil berisi 4 anak.

a47b654a0bbd2beacfc7.en: 6 cars leave 2 children behind, so 7 cars are needed.
a47b654a0bbd2beacfc7.id: 6 mobil menyisakan 2 anak, jadi perlu 7 mobil.

97f9ec3f4d56a1b1b4f8.en: 40 ÷ 6 = 6 r 4. The 4 extra eggs need one more box, so 7 boxes are needed.
97f9ec3f4d56a1b1b4f8.id: 40 ÷ 6 = 6 r 4. Sisa 4 telur perlu satu kotak lagi, jadi diperlukan 7 kotak.

0ff3b7af3acb2d1cce66.en: 31 × 8 = 248, and 250 - 248 = 2. Each friend gets 31 beads and 2 are left over.
0ff3b7af3acb2d1cce66.id: 31 × 8 = 248, dan 250 - 248 = 2. Setiap teman mendapat 31 manik-manik dan sisanya 2.

a64b787366a85c430d47.en: 100 ÷ 9 is 11 remainder 1. The last car needs another trip, so 12 trips are needed.
a64b787366a85c430d47.id: 100 ÷ 9 adalah 11 sisa 1. Mobil terakhir perlu satu perjalanan lagi, jadi diperlukan 12 perjalanan.

96132fc95e0b2a60434c.en: 50 ÷ 8 = 6 remainder 2. The 2 left over need another bus, so 7 buses.
96132fc95e0b2a60434c.id: 50 ÷ 8 = 6 sisa 2. Sisa 2 anak perlu satu bus lagi, jadi 7 bus.
